guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: How outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 台北 101 外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，深度為單層、雙層或三層
台北 101 八支巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，填充約 69 MPa 混凝土
哈里發塔在機械層設 5 組外伸臂，連結核心與周邊柱
上海中心沿高度分 9 區，區間設兩層高外伸與帶狀桁架，外伸桁架共 6 道
上海中心巨柱底部採 C70 混凝土，含鋼率約 4% 至 5%，軸壓比限值 0.65
上海中心大震分析中多數外伸與帶狀桁架保持彈性，平均層間變位角小於 1/130
均勻核心與均勻風載的簡化模型中，單道外伸臂最佳位置約在離地 0.54H
外伸臂通常佔 1 至 3 層樓高，多設於機電層或避難層
factsEn: Taipei 101's outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep
Taipei 101's eight mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, filled with about 69 MPa concrete
Burj Khalifa has 5 sets of outriggers at mechanical floors linking core and perimeter columns
Shanghai Tower has 9 zones with two-storey outrigger and belt trusses between them, 6 outrigger levels in all
Shanghai Tower's mega-columns use C70 concrete at the base, about 4% to 5% steel, with an axial-load ratio limit of 0.65
In Shanghai Tower's major-earthquake analysis most outrigger and belt trusses stayed elastic, with mean drift below 1/130
In a simplified model with a uniform core and wind, a single outrigger is best at about 0.54H above the base
Outriggers typically occupy 1 to 3 storeys and sit in mechanical or refuge floors
timeline: 2004　台北 101 完工，以多道外伸桁架連結八支巨柱與斜撐核心
2010　哈里發塔啟用，在機械層以五組外伸臂連結核心與周邊柱
2012　CTBUH 出版高層建築外伸臂設計技術指南
2015　上海中心完工，以六道兩層高外伸桁架與巨柱組成巨型框架
timelineEn: 2004 — Taipei 101 is completed, linking eight mega-columns to a braced core through multiple outriggers
2010 — Burj Khalifa opens with five sets of outriggers at mechanical floors tying core to perimeter columns
2012 — CTBUH publishes its technical guide on outrigger design for high-rise buildings
2015 — Shanghai Tower is completed with a mega-frame of six two-storey outriggers and super columns
codes: CTBUH 技術指南：高層建築外伸臂設計（2012）
JGJ 3-2010 高層建築混凝土結構技術規程（含加強層規定）
AISC 360：鋼結構建築規範（含合成構材與剪力釘）
ACI 209R：混凝土徐變、乾縮與溫度效應預測
codesEn: CTBUH Technical Guide: Outrigger Design for High-Rise Buildings (2012)
JGJ 3-2010 Technical Specification for Concrete Structures of Tall Buildings, including strengthened-storey provisions
AISC 360: Specification for Structural Steel Buildings, including composite members and shear studs
ACI 209R: Prediction of Creep, Shrinkage and Temperature Effects in Concrete Structures
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Mega-column and outrigger structural systems
guides.concept: 以台北 101、哈里發塔與上海中心為例，從外伸臂約束核心轉角的旋轉彈簧模型與單道外伸臂的最佳高度出發，處理巨柱有效長度與樓板支撐力、外伸桁架穿入核心牆的力傳遞，再到差異縮短與延遲鎖定、雙層高桁架的焊接收縮、應變監測回推勁度、阻尼外伸臂，最後是外伸臂樓層的改裝管控與長期徐變監測。
guides.conceptEn: Using Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa and Shanghai Tower as examples, start from the rotational-spring model of how outriggers restrain core rotation and from the optimum level of a single outrigger, handle mega-column effective length and floor bracing forces and force transfer where outrigger trusses enter core walls, then differential shortening and delayed lock-off, weld shrinkage in two-storey trusses, strain monitoring to back-calculate stiffness and damped outriggers, ending with alteration control on outrigger floors and long-term creep monitoring.
procedure: 只有核心筒的高樓像一根懸臂梁，側力下底部彎矩全由核心承擔，頂部變位大。外伸臂是從核心伸出、連到周邊巨柱的深桁架或牆：核心彎曲轉動時，外伸臂一端上翹、一端下壓，迫使兩側巨柱一拉一壓，柱的軸向勁度因此變成抵抗核心轉動的旋轉彈簧，產生反向彎矩。這個反向彎矩減少外伸臂以下核心的彎矩與整棟樓的頂部變位，效果取決於柱的軸向勁度、柱距與外伸臂本身的勁度。
外伸臂放在頂部時，連接的柱子最長、軸向勁度最小，回復彎矩只對頂部附近有效；放得太低時，柱子短而勁，但該處核心轉角很小，外伸臂幾乎不受力。最佳位置介於兩者之間：在均勻核心、均勻風載、外伸臂本身剛性的簡化模型中，單道外伸臂的最佳位置約在離地 0.54H（距頂約 0.46H），而且與柱的軸向勁度大小無關；多道外伸臂時大致沿高度平均分布。實務上還要配合機電層位置與建築使用。
巨柱斷面很大，在每層樓板都有側向支撐時幾乎不會挫屈；但超高層常有挑空大廳、空中大廳或雙層機電層，若巨柱在數層甚至數十公尺範圍內沒有樓板拉住，有效長度大增，二階效應會明顯放大彎矩。支撐巨柱的樓板或繫梁也必須設計成能承受柱子傾向側移所產生的支撐力，一般以柱軸力的一小部分估計。台北 101 與上海中心都以帶狀桁架或樓板把巨柱與其他構件連成整體。
外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿在核心牆處集中巨大的拉壓力，必須以埋入牆內的鋼骨、鋼板與剪力釘把力量擴散到混凝土牆中；鋼構與混凝土牆的介面是整個系統最複雜的接合。常見做法是讓弦桿穿過核心牆並與牆內鋼板或型鋼連續，或在牆內設置鋼板剪力牆區段；上海中心的核心牆在加強層內即以鋼板或型鋼補強。穿牆處同時有大量鋼筋、預埋件與澆置空間的衝突，需要三維協調。
巨柱與核心筒的應力水準、材料與施工時間不同，在重力、徐變與乾縮下的縮短量也不同；外伸臂若在施工初期就把兩者剛接，差異縮短會讓外伸臂像槓桿一樣被強迫變形，產生與風、地震無關的巨大附加力。常見做法是施工期間讓外伸臂的一端以長槽孔或可調整接頭保持可動，等主要的重力縮短發生後（例如封頂後）再鎖定，或使用可多次調整的千斤頂接頭。鎖定時機是設計與施工共同決定的關鍵參數。
兩層高的外伸桁架構件又大又重，常拆成可吊裝的分段，在高空以全滲透焊或高強度螺栓接合。大量厚板焊接會產生收縮，若焊接順序不當，收縮累積會讓桁架節點偏離設計位置、在構件中留下殘餘應力，甚至把核心埋件或巨柱拉偏。施工方以預留收縮量、對稱焊接、先組後焊與臨時支撐控制幾何，並同時考慮塔吊在該半徑的吊重能力。
外伸臂系統的實際效果取決於許多不確定因素：混凝土開裂後的核心勁度、接合的實際剛度、樓板參與程度與差異縮短的殘留量。在外伸臂斜桿、弦桿與相連巨柱上安裝應變計並量測溫度，可以把風或重力作用下的構件力量化，再與模型預測比較，回推系統的實際勁度分配。這些資料也是日後評估改裝或事件後狀態的基準。
阻尼外伸臂把外伸臂端部與巨柱之間原本的剛性接合換成垂直的黏滯阻尼器：核心彎曲轉動時，外伸臂端部與巨柱之間產生相對垂直位移，阻尼器在這個相對運動中耗能，為整棟樓提供附加阻尼，同時避免剛性外伸臂傳遞過大的力。阻尼效果取決於阻尼器兩端的相對位移：外伸臂或柱子太柔時，阻尼器兩端一起動，就耗不了多少能量。
外伸臂多設在機電層或避難層，這些樓層在營運期間經常需要更換設備、增設管線或改變用途。外伸桁架的斜桿與弦桿佔據大量空間，維修人員可能為了搬運設備或穿越管線而要求在構件上開孔、切割或焊接附掛物；任何一處削弱都可能切斷整個外伸臂的傳力路徑。因此外伸臂樓層在建築管理上必須被列為結構管制區，所有改裝都要經過結構審查。
外伸臂鎖定之後，巨柱與核心的徐變與乾縮仍會持續數年至十數年，殘留的差異縮短會慢慢增加外伸臂與巨柱的附加力，也可能讓樓板邊緣傾斜。長期監測以應變計、精密水準與接頭位移計追蹤這個過程，並與時間相依分析比較；交接文件要讓營運單位知道哪些數值屬於正常發展、何時需要請結構顧問評估。
procedureEn: A tower with only a core behaves like a cantilever: under lateral load the core carries the entire base moment and the top drifts a lot. An outrigger is a deep truss or wall extending from the core to perimeter mega-columns; when the core bends and rotates, one end of the outrigger lifts and the other presses down, forcing the columns on the two sides into tension and compression, so their axial stiffness becomes a rotational spring resisting core rotation and producing a counter-moment. That counter-moment reduces core moment below the outrigger and the building's top drift, by an amount that depends on column axial stiffness, column spacing and the outrigger's own stiffness.

Put at the top, an outrigger engages the longest, axially softest columns and its restoring moment acts only near the top; put too low, the columns are short and stiff but the core barely rotates there, so the outrigger hardly works. The optimum lies between: in a simplified model with a uniform core, uniform wind and a rigid outrigger arm, a single outrigger works best about 0.54H above the base, about 0.46H below the top, independent of column axial stiffness, and several outriggers are best spread roughly evenly up the height. In practice the levels also follow mechanical floors and building use.

Mega-columns are so large that they hardly buckle when every floor braces them laterally; but supertall towers often have atria, sky lobbies or double-height mechanical floors, and if a mega-column runs several storeys or tens of metres without a slab holding it, its effective length grows and second-order effects markedly amplify moments. Slabs or ties that brace mega-columns must also be designed for the bracing force generated by the column's tendency to sway, usually estimated as a small fraction of its axial load. Taipei 101 and Shanghai Tower both use belt trusses or slabs to tie mega-columns into the rest of the structure.

Outrigger chords and diagonals concentrate huge tension and compression where they meet the core, so steel sections, plates and shear studs embedded in the wall must spread that force into the concrete; the steel-to-concrete interface is the most complex connection in the system. Common solutions run the chord through the core wall continuously with embedded plates or sections, or form steel-plate shear-wall zones within the wall; Shanghai Tower's core walls are stiffened with steel plates or sections in the strengthened storeys. Where chords pass through, rebar, embeds and concreting space all compete, demanding three-dimensional coordination.

Mega-columns and the core differ in stress level, material and timing, so they shorten by different amounts under gravity, creep and shrinkage; if an outrigger rigidly joins them early in construction, differential shortening forces it to deform like a lever, inducing large extra forces unrelated to wind or earthquakes. The usual answer keeps one end of the outrigger free during construction through long slotted holes or adjustable joints, locking it after most gravity shortening has occurred, for example after topping out, or uses jacked joints that can be adjusted several times. The lock-off time is a key parameter decided jointly by design and construction.

Two-storey outrigger members are large and heavy, so they are usually split into liftable segments joined at height by full-penetration welds or high-strength bolts. Welding so much thick plate causes shrinkage; with a poor sequence it accumulates, pulling truss nodes off their design positions, leaving residual stresses and even dragging core embeds or mega-columns out of line. Contractors control geometry with shrinkage allowances, symmetric welding, assembly before welding and temporary supports, while respecting tower-crane capacity at the working radius.

An outrigger system's real effectiveness depends on many uncertainties: cracked core stiffness, actual joint rigidity, slab participation and residual differential shortening. Strain gauges with temperature sensing on outrigger diagonals, chords and connected mega-columns turn wind or gravity effects into member forces that can be compared with model predictions to back-calculate the real stiffness distribution. The data also become the baseline for later assessment of alterations or post-event condition.

A damped outrigger replaces the rigid joint between the outrigger tip and the mega-column with vertical viscous dampers: as the core bends and rotates, relative vertical movement arises between outrigger tip and column, and the dampers dissipate energy in that motion, adding damping to the whole building while avoiding the very large forces a rigid outrigger would transmit. The benefit depends on the relative displacement across the dampers: if the outrigger or columns are too flexible, both ends of the damper move together and little energy is dissipated.

Outriggers usually sit in mechanical or refuge floors, which in service often need equipment replacement, new services or changes of use. Outrigger diagonals and chords occupy much of the space, and maintenance staff may ask to cut openings, trim members or weld attachments to move equipment or run services; any one weakening can sever the load path of the whole outrigger. Outrigger floors must therefore be designated structural control zones in building management, with every alteration subject to structural review.

After lock-off, creep and shrinkage of mega-columns and core continue for years or even more than a decade, and the residual differential shortening slowly adds force to outriggers and columns and can tilt slab edges. Long-term monitoring with strain gauges, precise levelling and joint displacement gauges tracks this process against time-dependent analysis, and handover documents must tell the operator which values are normal development and when to call in the structural consultant.
evidence: 設計文件要說明外伸臂系統的力學假設（剛性或彈性、接合鎖定時機、樓板是否參與），並在接合細部圖上標明哪些螺栓在施工期保持可滑動、何時鎖定，由結構設計者確認。
概念設計階段就以簡化模型做外伸臂位置的敏感度分析，並與建築、機電團隊共同決定加強層樓層；比選紀錄保留在設計基準書，日後若需變更加強層位置，可據以快速評估影響。
在結構圖上標示每支巨柱的支撐樓層與無支撐長度，任何挑空或樓板開口變更都必須回到結構設計者；施工計畫規定巨柱領先樓板的最大層數與臨時支撐方式。
加強層的鋼構、牆內鋼板、鋼筋與澆置孔要在同一個三維模型中定案，並以試作段確認施工可行；澆置前設停止點，由結構設計者確認剪力釘、埋件與鋼筋的位置與檢驗紀錄。
施工計畫要訂出外伸臂的暫時狀態、鎖定條件（例如封頂後且實測差異小於設定值）與施工期強風應變措施；鎖定作業設停止點，由結構設計者依監測資料簽認。
evidenceEn: Design documents should state the mechanical assumptions of the outrigger system (rigid or flexible, when joints are locked, whether slabs participate) and mark on connection details which bolts stay free to slip during construction and when they are locked, confirmed by the structural designer.

Run a sensitivity study of outrigger level with a simplified model at the concept stage and decide the strengthened floors jointly with the architecture and services teams; keep the comparison in the design basis so any later change in level can be assessed quickly.

Mark the bracing floors and unbraced lengths of every mega-column on the structural drawings, route any atrium or slab-opening change back to the structural designer, and set in the construction plan the maximum number of floors mega-columns may run ahead of slabs, with the temporary bracing method.

Finalise strengthened-storey steel, embedded plates, rebar and placement openings in one three-dimensional model and prove constructability with a trial section; set a hold point before concreting at which the structural designer confirms stud, embed and rebar positions and inspection records.

The construction plan defines the outriggers' temporary state, the lock-off conditions (for example after topping out and with measured difference below a set value) and construction-stage storm measures; lock-off is a hold point signed by the structural designer on the basis of monitoring data.
pitfalls: 若模型把外伸臂與柱的連接當成完全剛接，而實際接合因螺栓滑動或焊接變形而較柔，外伸臂效果被高估，核心與基礎承受的彎矩超過設計；樓板若被當成外伸臂的一部分卻沒有足夠的面內強度，地震時會在核心邊緣開裂。
建築變更新增挑空時若未通知結構設計者，巨柱失去數層支撐，二階彎矩可能讓柱在大震或強風時失穩；施工期間巨柱領先樓板太多，未支撐長度遠超設計，風力或吊裝碰撞就可能造成過大變形。
若外伸臂在施工早期被焊死，數十公釐的差異縮短可能讓斜桿或接合在完工前就接近降伏，或在核心牆內造成裂縫；若鎖定太晚，施工期間遭遇強風時外伸臂無法發揮作用，核心單獨承受風力。
應變計只裝在構件單側時，彎曲應變會被誤當成軸力；未做溫度補償時，日照造成的應變變化可能比風造成的還大，得出錯誤的勁度結論。
機電承包商為了更換大型設備而切斷一根斜桿，外伸臂的力流被打斷，強風或地震時核心與基礎承受遠超設計的彎矩；這種損傷平時看不出來，只有在極端事件中才會暴露。
pitfallsEn: If the model treats the outrigger-to-column joint as fully rigid while the real joint is softer through bolt slip or weld distortion, the outrigger's benefit is overestimated and the core and foundation see more moment than designed; floor slabs counted as part of the outrigger without enough in-plane strength crack at the core edge in an earthquake.

An architectural change that adds an atrium without telling the structural designer removes several floors of bracing, and second-order moments can destabilise the column in a major earthquake or strong wind; during construction, mega-columns that run far ahead of the slabs have unbraced lengths well beyond design, so wind or lifting impacts can cause excessive deformation.

If outriggers are welded solid early in construction, tens of millimetres of differential shortening can drive diagonals or joints close to yield before completion or crack the core walls; lock off too late and the outriggers cannot work during a construction-stage storm, leaving the core to resist wind alone.
Gauges on one face only mistake bending strain for axial force; without temperature compensation, solar strain changes can exceed wind-induced ones and lead to wrong stiffness conclusions.

A services contractor cutting through a diagonal to replace large equipment interrupts the outrigger's force flow, so in strong wind or earthquakes the core and foundation take moments far beyond design; the damage is invisible day to day and exposed only in an extreme event.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 台北 101
related.transfer: 可遷移「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」與「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；台北 101的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "How outriggers restrain core rotation" and "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taipei 101 must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂；台北 101則以以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers; Taipei 101 centres on deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」與「角隅鋸齒缺角」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台北 101，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” and “Sawtooth corner notches”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taipei 101, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.summary: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統：外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂。
courses.summaryEn: Mega-column and outrigger structural systems: How outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
history.text: 外伸臂系統的想法是讓核心筒不再單獨抵抗傾覆，而是以深桁架把周邊柱拉進來形成力偶；隨著建築高度與細長比增加，這個做法在超高層中成為主流，並常與機電層、避難層結合。台北 101（2004）以多道單層至三層高的外伸桁架連結八支巨柱與斜撐核心，哈里發塔（2010）在機械層設五組外伸臂，上海中心（2015）則以六道兩層高外伸桁架、帶狀桁架與巨柱組成巨型框架；CTBUH 在 2012 年出版外伸臂設計技術指南，整理差異縮短、接合與阻尼外伸臂等議題。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The idea of an outrigger system is that the core no longer resists overturning alone: deep trusses draw the perimeter columns in to form a couple. As building height and slenderness grew, the approach became mainstream in supertall towers, usually combined with mechanical and refuge floors. Taipei 101 (2004) links eight mega-columns to a braced core through multiple outriggers one to three storeys deep, Burj Khalifa (2010) has five sets of outriggers at mechanical floors, and Shanghai Tower (2015) forms a mega-frame from six two-storey outrigger trusses, belt trusses and super columns; in 2012 CTBUH published a technical guide on outrigger design covering differential shortening, connections and damped outriggers. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」到「外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "How outriggers restrain core rotation" through "Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
